result.topic_en: Calculations on one-dimensional gas dynamics with pressure p=φ(ρ): the Riemann invariants r, s with u ± f(ρ), the hodograph-type linear equation for t (or w) in the variables r, s with a series solution attempt, and shock (discontinuity) conditions relating velocities and densities on both sides of a jump.
result.transcription:
$p = \varphi(\varrho)$
$-\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = -\varphi'(\varrho)\frac{\partial \log\varrho}{\partial x}$
$-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial \log\varrho}{\partial t} + u\frac{\partial \log\varrho}{\partial x}$

$\partial u + \lambda\,\partial\log\varrho = \partial(u + f(\varrho))$
$\partial u + \frac{\varphi'(\varrho)}{\lambda}\partial\log\varrho$

$\int\sqrt{\varphi'\varrho}\,\partial\log\varrho = f(\varrho)$

$\frac{\partial f(\varrho)}{\partial\log\varrho}$

$u + f(\varrho) = 2r$ $\quad u = r - s$
$-u + f(\varrho) = 2s$ $\quad f(\varrho) = r + s$

$\frac{\partial r}{\partial t} = -(u + \varrho f'(\varrho))\frac{\partial r}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial t} = -(u - \varrho f'(\varrho))\frac{\partial s}{\partial x}$

$\frac{\partial x}{\partial s} = (u + \varrho f'(\varrho))\frac{\partial t}{\partial s}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial r} = (u - \varrho f'(\varrho))\frac{\partial t}{\partial r}$

$2\varrho f'(\varrho)\frac{\partial^2 t}{\partial r\partial s} + \frac{\partial t}{\partial s}\left(1 + \frac{\partial^2 f\varrho}{\partial\log\varrho^2}\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial f\varrho}\right) + \frac{\partial t}{\partial r}\left(1 + \frac{\partial^2 f\varrho}{\partial\log\varrho^2}\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial f\varrho}\right)$

$\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial f\varrho}{\partial\log\varrho}}{\partial\log\varrho} + 1 = \frac{\partial\log\varrho^2 f'(\varrho)}{\partial\log\varrho}$

$\frac{\partial f(\varrho)}{\partial\log\varrho^2 f(\varrho)}$

$v_1\varrho_1\omega\partial t = v_2\varrho_2\omega\partial t$
$([-\varphi\varrho_1-]\ \varphi(\varrho_1) - \varphi(\varrho_2))\omega\partial t = (v_2 - v_1)v_1\varrho_1\omega\partial t$

$v_1 = \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}\frac{\varphi(\varrho_1) - \varphi(\varrho_2)}{\varrho_1 - \varrho_2}}$

$\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t} = u_1 + \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}\frac{\varphi(\varrho_1) - \varphi(\varrho_2)}{\varrho_1 - \varrho_2}} = u_2 + \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}\frac{\varphi(\varrho_1) - \varphi(\varrho_2)}{\varrho_1 - \varrho_2}}$

$u_1 + \sqrt{\varphi'(\varrho_1)}$ $\quad u_2 + \sqrt{\varphi'(\varrho_2)}$

$u_1 + \sqrt{\varphi'(\varrho_1)} - (u_2 + \sqrt{\varphi'\varrho_2}) = \sqrt{\frac{(\varrho_1 - \varrho_2)(\varphi(\varrho_1) - \varphi(\varrho_2))}{\varrho_1\varrho_2}} + \sqrt{\varphi'\varrho_1} - \sqrt{\varphi'(\varrho_2)}$

$\varrho_1 > \varrho_2$
$\varphi'(\varrho_1) \gtrless \varphi'(\varrho_2)$

$1 + (r - r')(s - s')$ $\quad$ [-$=$-] $\frac{\partial w}{\partial r} = \int f(r+s)\,w\,\partial s$

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s}$ [-$= f(r+s)\,w$-]

$w = \sum (r - r')^m (s - s')^m$ [-$\varphi_m(r+s)$-] $\varphi_m(\sigma, \sigma')$

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s} = \sum$ [-...-] $\varphi_m(r'+s')\left(\varphi_m''(r+s)(r-r')(s-s') + \varphi_m'(r+s)\,m(r - r' + s - s') + \right.$
$+ \varphi_m'(r+s)\,m^2$ [-...-]

$\frac{\partial(x - \overline{u + \varrho f'(\varrho)}\,t)}{\partial s} = $ [-$1 +$-] $\frac{\partial^2 f\varrho}{\partial\log\varrho^2}\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial f\varrho}\,t = -\frac{\partial\log f'(\varrho)}{\partial\log\varrho}\,t \quad f(r+s)$

$\frac{\partial\, x - u - \varrho f'\varrho\, t}{\partial r} = -1 + \frac{\partial^2 f\varrho}{\partial\log\varrho^2}$ $\quad = 0$

$w = \sum (r - r')^m (s - s')^m \varphi_m(\sigma, \sigma')$
$\varphi_m''(\sigma, \sigma')\,[?] + m(\varphi_m'(\sigma, \sigma')(\sigma - \sigma') + m^2\varphi_m(\sigma, \sigma') + f(\sigma)\varphi_m(\sigma, \sigma')$
$m\varphi_m^{1,1}(\sigma, \sigma')(\sigma - \sigma')$.

$(x - (u + \varrho f'(\varrho))t)\,\partial r - (x - (u - \varrho f'(\varrho))t)\,\partial s = \partial w$

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s} = -\frac{\partial\log f'(\varrho)}{\partial\log\varrho}\,t = -\frac{\varrho}{f'(\varrho)} f''\varrho\, t$ $\quad (\sigma - \sigma')m\,\varphi^{1,2}(\sigma, \sigma') - 2m\,\varphi^{1,1}(\sigma, \sigma')$
$+ m^2\varphi^{2,2}[?] + f(\sigma)\varphi_m^{2,2}(\sigma, \sigma')$

$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial r\partial s} = \frac{f''(\varrho)}{(f'(\varrho))^2}\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial s}\right)$ $\quad \frac{\partial w}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial s} = -\varrho f'(\varrho)\,t$

$f(\varrho) = \sigma$
$\frac{f''\varrho}{(f'(\varrho))^2} = -\frac{\partial\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial\sigma}}{\partial\sigma}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial\varrho} = -\frac{\partial\log\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial\sigma}}{\partial\sigma}$
